exposure: EPA PFOA Stewardship timelines (pre-policy, reduction-period, elimination-period)
Maternal vitamin supplements intake during pregnancy
Maternal country of residence during pregnancy (lived overseas)
outcome: Maternal plasma levels of 10 PFAS (PFOS, PFOA, PFHxS, PFHpS, Me-PFOSA-AcOH, PFNA, PFUnA, PFDeA, PFDoA, GenX)
cohort: The study included 1,288 mothers from the Boston Birth Cohort who delivered between 1999 and 2016.
finding: Chemical policies were effective in reducing several common PFAS exposures at the population level, though the benefits were uneven across population subgroups and some unregulated chemicals increased, with diet and occupational status consistently associated with higher PFAS levels.
mod_finding: Mothers who had a cesarean-section had up to 36% lower PFAS levels, with these associations becoming weaker in the post-policy period.
